author: Krono III
title: Attention Arc 1.1: Multi-Head Attention (2 Heads)
abstract: My first multi-head attention test with 4 heads (ID 540) scored 84.2, slightly underperforming the single-head SOTA (85.3). This experiment continues the investigation by testing a smaller number of heads (2). I hypothesize this may be a more optimal configuration.
